title: SSS Archive v2
description:
SSS Archive v2 / SSS Records

An offline-first Windows desktop application for organizing archive records and their supporting documents. Each computer keeps its own local SQLite workspace, with no internet connection required for normal use.

Implemented features
- Connected GRDS and SSS RDS classification trees, searchable archive registers, and record forms that preserve saved classification and retention details.
- Supporting-document storage and previews, received-date dashboards, and PDF, Excel, CSV, and print reports.
- Bundled local AI and OCR assistance for preparing record drafts and finding records, with human review before saving.
- Reviewable database transfers between computers, conflict handling, recovery snapshots, and encrypted full-workspace backups.
- Light/dark appearance and accessibility settings for text size, contrast, controls, and reduced motion.

Technology: Vue 3, TypeScript, Electron, Node.js, SQLite, and Tesseract.js.

Platform: Windows desktop. This is the standalone version 2 project, separate from the original version 1 application.
shortSummary: An offline Windows archive workspace with connected classifications, document management, local AI/OCR assistance, and reviewable database transfers.

title: Kiko's Order Planner
description:
Kiko's Order Planner

An internal web application for organizing food orders from booking through preparation and handoff. Owner and Staff permissions separate daily operations from account, menu, payment, cancellation, and financial-report administration.

Implemented features
- Customer contacts and order creation, editing, drafts, duplication, filtering, and preparation history.
- Month, week, and day calendars with daily agendas for delivery and pickup schedules.
- Payment/refund records, balances, and role-based dashboard summaries.
- Operational and financial reports with PDF, Excel, CSV, and print exports.
- Opt-in offline order/calendar access and queued order changes that synchronize after reconnecting.
- Responsive desktop and mobile layouts, staff profiles, and recorded action attribution.

Technology: Vue 3, TypeScript, Laravel, PHP, and Tailwind CSS. MySQL is the production database target.

Status: implemented and locally verified. Production hosting and live business acceptance remain pending; no public application URL is listed.
shortSummary: An internal food-order planner with customer contacts, fulfillment calendars, preparation tracking, payment records, and operational reports.

title: Blank
description:
Blank / Personal Finance Tracker

A Windows-first desktop application for managing personal finances in a local workspace. Its interface combines customizable wallet cards, clear financial summaries, and a Liquid Glass visual style.

Implemented features
- Bank, e-wallet, and cash account sections with customizable card appearance and arrangement.
- Income and expense entries, transfers, recurring income receipts, and editable categories.
- Planned payments, receivables, debts, category budgets, and savings goals.
- Image/PDF receipts, reports, dashboard charts, balance reminders, and local Tarsi backup import.
- Profile customization, multiple appearance themes, and a packaged Windows installer.

Technology: React, TypeScript, Tauri 2, Rust, SQLite, and Recharts.

Platform: Windows desktop. Web and mobile clients are planned; this entry does not present them as released applications.
shortSummary: A local-first personal finance desktop app for accounts, income and expenses, transfers, budgets, goals, receipts, and financial insights.
